newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 20.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 20.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Tuesday and main factors likely to affect trading:
* Investors are expected to remain defensive ahead of the Federal Reserve interest rate policy meeting, traders said.

* "Foreign investors are going back to blue chip countries like the U.S. and they are still underweighting the region. Our mettle is still being tested," Ramon Adviento, analyst at Sun Hung Kai Securities Phils Inc.
* Shares may move in a narrow range after three days of losses, said Elline Salvatierra, analyst at Dharmala Securities.
